description: List a website's linked backend logs, such as Axiom datasets, with one source's fields (name:type) and what they mean: fieldRoles (the field holding status, route, user_id...) and customerFields (fields matching people or accounts the website knows). Call before query_logs, whose filters use these names.

match.description: Part of a field name to look for, ignoring case (status, duration, user); lists only matching fields. null for all.

sourceId.description: A source id from an earlier list_log_sources call, to list its fields; null for the only one.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: list_log_sources
title: List log sources
